title: The Pile at the Edge
hook: Somebody left a ridge of gravel along the shoulder.
scene: A windrow runs the right edge for the next half mile — loose gravel piled where the grader pushed it and never came back. It looks like shoulder. It is a rope laid along the road.

source.psdp_skill: Skill twelve: driving on rural roads
source.teaching_target: PSDP twelve — gravel windrow / pile at the edge. PSDP-only (n/a DOL).

image_brief.subject: a continuous ridge of loose gravel piled along the right edge for the next half mile; cabin always shows hard-sided pet carrier; wire grille door facing inboard; Gracie (ginger orange tabby) markings visible behind the grille; seatbelt routed through the carrier handle; latched and strapped
image_brief.foreground: worn black wheel, faded pink dash, coarse mesh;; hard-sided pet carrier; wire grille door facing inboard; Gracie (ginger orange tabby) markings visible behind the grille; seatbelt routed through the carrier handle; latched and strapped on the passenger floor (wheels turning)
image_brief.midground: gravel windrow running the right shoulder like a rope; travel track clear left of it
image_brief.background: overcast rural two-lane, soft dirt beyond the pile, no other cars
image_brief.read: a grader windrow of loose gravel lines the right edge; it looks like shoulder and is not
extra_negatives: no wheels already off the pavement
no second person in the car
no cat loose on the seat
no digital speed readout reading as live speed
no missing carrier when cabin or cage is in frame
Ali alone — only VI-013 has a second person
no carrier door facing outboard/camera unless brief says otherwise
no empty carrier with no cat visible behind grille
no belt not routed through handle

geometry.ego_lane_side: right half of a two-lane rural road, still on the travel surface
geometry.ego_nose_in_frame: plow bar at the bottom of the glass, pointing up-frame

variation.forced: Act VI Claude follow-up (21aded1a): carrier SPEC locked; zero ship prior priority; stills pending muted-read; do not seed; no Mya

decision: The windrow is on your right. Where do you put the tires?

options.text: Left of it, in the graded track, and give it room
options.result: You stay in the part somebody meant you to drive on. The pile sits out there being a pile.

options.text: Straddle it so you are using the full width
options.result: One wheel in loose and one in packed, and the car starts arguing with itself about which way is straight.

options.text: Ride the far right so oncoming traffic has all the room it wants
options.result: You put the right side into the windrow to be generous. It takes the wheel out of your hands and points you at the ditch.
It is gravel that is six inches deep in a line. That is not the same gravel you are already on.

debrief: Watch for windrows — piled gravel at the road edge grabs a wheel.
